document.text: Only high-level validation metrics are shared with the LLM, but no validation sample is leaked. PGKD uses early stopping to control the overall validation loss. PGKD returns the model having the lowest validation loss as the best model to be used for testing. PGKD then computes the model val_results on the validation set Dval and leverages an LLM to generate new training data Di+1 tailored to these findings.
